description: This file defines a set of custom matchers for Playwright testing framework, including functions for assertions on locators, pages, and responses, such as visibility, text content, attributes, URL, and response status.

classes.name: ExpectMatcherStateInternal
classes.description: Extended state for expectation matchers including step info and utility functions.

classes.name: LocatorEx
classes.description: Extended Locator interface with custom expectation method.

classes.name: FrameEx
classes.description: Extended Frame interface with custom expectation method.

methods.name: toBeAttached
methods.description: Checks if a locator is attached or detached.

methods.name: toBeChecked
methods.description: Checks if a locator is checked, unchecked, or indeterminate.

methods.name: toBeDisabled
methods.description: Checks if a locator is disabled.

methods.name: toBeEditable
methods.description: Checks if a locator is editable or read-only.

methods.name: toBeEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a locator is empty.

methods.name: toBeEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a locator is enabled.

methods.name: toBeFocused
methods.description: Checks if a locator is focused.

methods.name: toBeHidden
methods.description: Checks if a locator is hidden.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if a locator is visible or hidden.

methods.name: toBeInViewport
methods.description: Checks if a locator is in the viewport.

methods.name: toContainText
methods.description: Checks if a locator contains specified text or regex.

methods.name: toHaveAccessibleDescription
methods.description: Checks accessible description of a locator.

methods.name: toHaveAccessibleName
methods.description: Checks accessible name of a locator.

methods.name: toHaveAccessibleErrorMessage
methods.description: Checks accessible error message of a locator.

methods.name: toHaveAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a locator has a specific attribute with expected value.

methods.name: toHaveClass
methods.description: Checks if a locator has specific class(es).

methods.name: toContainClass
methods.description: Checks if a locator contains specific class(es).

methods.name: toHaveCount
methods.description: Checks the count of elements matching locator.

methods.name: toHaveCSS
methods.description: Checks CSS property value.

methods.name: toHaveId
methods.description: Checks element ID.

methods.name: toHaveJSProperty
methods.description: Checks JavaScript property value.

methods.name: toHaveRole
methods.description: Checks ARIA role.

methods.name: toHaveText
methods.description: Checks text content of locator.

methods.name: toHaveValue
methods.description: Checks value of form element.

methods.name: toHaveValues
methods.description: Checks multiple values.

methods.name: toHaveTitle
methods.description: Checks page title.

methods.name: toHaveURL
methods.description: Checks page URL.

methods.name: toBeOK
methods.description: Checks if API response is OK.

methods.name: toPass
methods.description: Retries a callback until it passes or times out.

methods.name: computeMatcherTitleSuffix
methods.description: Computes suffix for matcher title based on context.
